ox-alpha-260821: **Provenance (added 2026-08-26).** Measured while the model was an anonymous stealth preview on OpenRouter (`stealth/ox-alpha`, 20–26 Aug 2026), attributed to lab *Unknown*. On 26 Aug 2026 Z.ai confirmed it was [GLM-5.3-Flash](https://x.com/Zai_org/status/2092616204787626030) (320B-A18B, MIT licence, natively multimodal, 1M context, served on Chinese AI chips); the identification had been made earlier that day from tokenizer and serving-layer forensics ([LuminaBench](https://x.com/LuminaBench/status/2092563960100745247), [Adam Holter](https://x.com/AdamHoltererer/status/2092579670407397667)). This page is preserved unchanged as a historical record of the stealth deployment, so it can be compared with the named release; it is *not* the measurement of the released GLM-5.3-Flash.
